result:
Direction SE-013 is complete: the Governance gateway detail now manages AgentCore Gateway rate limits end to end, `make verify` passes, and the tree is clean on three commits.

## 1. Changed

- `backend/app/services/agentcore/policy.py` — new wrappers `list_gateway_rate_limits` (all `nextToken` pages), `get_gateway_rate_limit`, `create_gateway_rate_limit` (optional `clientToken`), `update_gateway_rate_limit`, `delete_gateway_rate_limit`; control client passed explicitly.
- `backend/app/services/governance.py` — `validate_rate_limit_spec` (all documented rules, 422 `governance.rate_limit_invalid` with `detail.reason`), `list_rate_limits`, `create_rate_limit`, `update_rate_limit`, `delete_rate_limit`, and `_journaled_rate_limit_call` which writes the `PolicyChange` row as `running` around the synchronous call and closes it `succeeded`/`failed` inline.
- `backend/app/schemas/governance.py` — `RateLimitCreateRequest` / `RateLimitUpdateRequest` (accept `dimension_keys` or `dimensionKeys`; update carries the field only so the service can 422 it).
- `backend/app/routers/governance.py` — `GET`/`POST` `/api/governance/gateways/{id}/rate-limits`, `PUT`/`DELETE` `/{rate_limit_id}` (own path pattern allowing dots, as AWS does); `POST` is 201.
- `backend/app/core/route_policy.py` — four MEMBER entries.
- `backend/tests/test_governance_rate_limits.py` — 37 hermetic tests (stub control client via monkeypatched `control_client`).
- `frontend/src/lib/api.ts` — rate-limit types and four client methods.
- `frontend/src/pages/governance/rateLimits.ts` — pure client-side mirror of the rules (key catalogue, trailing `*`, period matrix, bounds), draft model, wire conversion.
- `frontend/src/pages/governance/RateLimitsPanel.tsx` — the RATE LIMITS panel (table with expandable entries, ADD form, EDIT ENTRIES with locked keys, DELETE via `ConfirmDialog`, semantics note, `disabledReason` on every gated button).
- `frontend/src/pages/governance/GatewayDetailView.tsx` — mounts the panel right after POLICIES; REFRESH reaches it through a counter.
- `frontend/src/theme/app.css` — `.gov-rl-*` styles.
- `frontend/src/locales/{en,zh-CN}/common.json` — `governance.rateLimits.*` block, full-width zh-CN punctuation.
- `docs/architecture.md` + `docs/architecture.zh-CN.md` — Gateway row plus a rate-limits subsection (rules table, journaling, semantics); zh-CN gains a new "既有 Gateway 治理：限流" section since it had no governance section before.
- `docs/api.md` + `docs/api.zh-CN.md` — four routes, request shape, `detail.reason` list, error mapping, journaling.

## 3. Acceptance checks

- ✅ `pytest -k rate_limit`: list follows two `nextToken` pages; create sends exactly `gatewayIdentifier`, `dimensionKeys`, `entries`, `description`, `clientToken`; parametrized 422 cases cover unknown key, duplicate key, >10 keys, leading `*`, dimensions ≠ keys, no metric, `tokens`/`second`, `connections`/`minute`, rate >10M, rate <0, description >512, `dimensionKeys` on update (both spellings); unmanaged → 409 `governance.gateway_not_managed` with no AWS mutation; stub `ConflictException` → 409 `aws.conflict` and a `failed` journal row; one `policy_changes` row per mutation with the right `operation`/`before`/`after`; delete calls `delete_gateway_rate_limit(gatewayIdentifier, rateLimitId)`.
- ✅ `test_route_policy.py` + `test_client_funnel.py` pass.
- ✅ Frontend: probe confirmed list / empty / error states, leading `*` and `tokens` per `second` blocked client-side with the reason on the disabled SAVE, correct POST/PUT/DELETE wire bodies, locked keys on edit, unmanaged ADD explains itself, zh-CN renders. tsc, lint, and both i18n scripts clean. Screenshots in `runs/SE-013/ui-list.png`, `ui-form.png`, `ui-error.png`.
- ✅ Docs: all four files updated.
- ✅ `make verify` passes.
- ⬜ Live AWS check: **not exercised**. No AWS call was made; the host may create a `[targetName]` / `*` requests-per-minute limit on the dev gateway, observe `ACTIVE`, and delete it.

## 4. Not done / deviations

- **DELETE returns 200 with `{deleted: true, id, status}`** rather than 204, since a 204 cannot carry the body the brief also asked for. Matches the existing unmanage route.
- **Rate-limit ids get their own path pattern** (`RATE_LIMIT_ID`, dots allowed) because AWS's `rateLimitId` pattern permits `.` while `RESOURCE_ID` does not.
- **JWT claim names follow botocore's pattern** (at least 2 chars, `[a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]`), so a claim like `custom:tenant` is rejected client- and server-side. AWS rejects it too.
- **Two extra reasons beyond the brief's list:** `entry_dimension_empty` and `rate_config_count` (AWS allows exactly one config per metric). Both are documented.
- **The ADD form's period select offers both periods for every metric** so the client-side period check is real and testable, as the acceptance list requires; the blocker text explains the matrix.
- **Update derives the key set from `GetGatewayRateLimit`** for the `before` snapshot and validation; if that read fails, keys fall back to the first entry's dimensions and `before` is `{}`, so journaling never blocks the mutation.
- Rate-limit mutations are not blocked by an in-flight policy operation (they don't touch the Gateway record), unlike the policy 202 path.
- No frontend unit-test runner exists in the repo, so the UI acceptance was verified with the stubbed Playwright probe saved under `runs/SE-013/` rather than a committed test.
